prior_findings.assessment: Main and temp metadata are checked with SQLite NOCASE; aliases, view/type mismatch, shadow object, missing/null fields and query failures reject. Canonical absent/legacy paths remain distinct. Real SQLite negative tests are authored.

Unknown delivery and successful POST followed by failed GET retain identity-bound write latch. Only same-target successful read reconciles effective values plus both revisions. Draft retained, no automatic mutation retry. Known pre-mutation 400/401/403 can release latch.

Exact top-level field allowlist rejects duplicates, case aliases and null; 8192-byte cap and EOF check reject oversized/trailing input. This is not a generic recursive JSON validator: current configuration canonicalizers reject object/nested-array/null elements for supported scalar/int-array keys. Future structured configuration types require separate recursive ambiguity policy.

required_before_test.finding: Synchronous Python SQLite fault-injection child has no timeout. A hung child blocks the Playwright worker event loop, so the per-case asynchronous timeout cannot bound this call.
required_before_test.required_change: Set explicit spawnSync timeout (e.g. 10000 ms), bounded maxBuffer, assert error absent, signal null and exit status zero. Keep owned-database-only trigger and put targeted trigger removal in finally after successful creation. Do not increase product or browser time limits.

required_before_test.finding: Second student is created but only its effective configuration DTO is read before/after. Neither student has browser-driven card progression in this journey; this does not establish actual cross-student card/lesson isolation or that the changed ladder is consumed after restart.
required_before_test.required_change: Add an independent student B browser context with real login, enable/placement and deterministic real mock classroom completion; capture its card progression and lesson identity before the admin change. After changing student A, assert B card fields and lesson identity remain unchanged by the admin operation, then continue B through a real answer/completion and assert expected progress. For A, verify persisted effective configuration after owned-server restart and a real subsequent scheduling/card outcome under the new ladder. Use real product actions; read-only DB/API observations may assert fields, but do not fabricate successful results or seed progress by SQL. Preserve existing response-loss/manual-reconciliation and fault recovery assertions. Exact serial scheduling outcome may be covered by Go tests; do not label DTO-only equality as a multi-student classroom journey.

invariant_review: Persistent mutation owns writer-first safe atomic boundary; effective before/after selection, affected card step-only clamp, configuration revisions and audit share transaction. No due/status promotion is introduced.
Native memory work clones and serialization retain settlement ownership; mixed storage combinations reject rather than claiming atomicity. The concurrency tests remain unexecuted.

Fresh durable configuration reads/work are used after Reload failure for new Hub room, placement scheduling and completion. Old Room/persisted classroom snapshot retains original configuration. No cross-App push invalidation is claimed; fresh transaction reads provide consistency.
New consumer regression fixture uses real persisted users/book/cards/lesson from durableSettlementFixture; it does not pre-create a Room, allowing the new-room check to exercise fresh configuration.

Cross-App placement consumer test uses another App sharing the database pool; this tests stale App cache, not independent-pool contention. Independent-pool write serializability belongs to the separate concurrency test.
Cancellation test is pre-cancel plus no-op-delete fault triggers; it must not be reported as all mid-transaction cancellation timings.

Admin mutation scope/role/target validation remains explicit. System Agent tool key permissions are not expanded. Pilot schema protection is conservative refusal, not Pilot classroom/Agent integration.
Candidate logs use fixed outcomes/count summaries; review does not establish runtime log completeness without execution.
